title: About Us
key_finding: The official Jacksonville Beach Police Department page says the department is a CALEA-accredited full-service law-enforcement agency with 100 sworn officers and employees, lists patrol and specialized units, and links to annual reports.

title: Chief Gene Paul Smith
key_finding: The official city site identifies Gene Paul Smith as the current police chief and describes his long service across Jacksonville Beach Police Department operations.

title: FY 2026 Annual Budget
key_finding: The adopted FY2026 budget names Gene P. Smith as Chief of the Police Department, shows police as a funded city business plan, and lists current police-protection summary statistics.

title: Police Department Annual Reports Archive
key_finding: The official police archive center publishes Jacksonville Beach Police Department annual reports and currently exposes archived annual reports for 2016, 2017, and 2018.

title: 2018 Annual Report (PDF)
key_finding: The 2018 Jacksonville Beach Police Department annual report publishes city crime and traffic statistics, including 2018 counts for homicide, robbery, burglary, larceny, and motor-vehicle theft.

title: 2011 Peyton Transition Report - Chapter on Office of the Sheriff
key_finding: Jacksonville's consolidation materials say the sheriff structure brought Jacksonville and Duval law enforcement under one entity while the three beach communities retained separate police departments.

title: County and Municipal Offense Report 2020A
key_finding: FDLE's 2020 county-and-municipal offense report lists Jacksonville Beach Police Department as a Duval municipal row with population 23,394 and total index crime 850.

title: County and Municipal Offense Report 2021A
key_finding: FDLE's 2021 county-and-municipal report retains Jacksonville Beach Police Department as a named municipal row with population 24,075 but blanks the offense cells during the transition year.

title: FIBRS Offense Detail 2021-2025 Q2 workbook
key_finding: The official FDLE FIBRS workbook contains no Jacksonville Beach Police Department row in the 2021, 2022, 2023, or 2024 sheets, but Jacksonville Beach reappears in the 2025 Q2 sheet.

title: agency_rosters_2024.csv
key_finding: The official FBI CDE 2024 agency roster lists FL0160300 Jacksonville Beach Police Department as a City agency with `is_nibrs` true and `nibrs_start_date` 2025-01-01.

title: ori_source_validation_2024.csv
publisher: CrimeRisk repo using official FBI CDE roster inputs
key_finding: The validation artifact classifies FL0160300 as present_but_no_2024_observation with issue official_nibrs_start_after_2024.

title: fdle_fibrs_2024_offense_period_extract.csv
key_finding: The normalized extract built from FDLE's official 2024 FIBRS workbook contains no Jacksonville Beach agency row.

title: agency_to_jurisdiction_crosswalk.parquet
key_finding: The live crosswalk routes FL0160300 exclusively to 12:municipal:place:1235050 Jacksonville Beach city.

title: agency_master.parquet
key_finding: FL0160300 is classified as a local_police agency and still carries SRS and NIBRS presence flags through 2024 despite the missing public 2021-2024 state offense rows.

title: agency_year_observations.parquet
key_finding: Repo observations show Jacksonville Beach annual support in 2018, 2019, and 2020, followed by zero-valued annual rows from 2021 through 2024.

title: jurisdiction_controls_2024.parquet
key_finding: All 2024 Jacksonville Beach offense controls are fully filled because preferred reported support is zero and the row is treated as structurally missing or unreliable.

title: municipal_target_review_queue.parquet
key_finding: Jacksonville Beach is queued in high_impact_full_fill_place with suspect_reason full_fill_no_reported_support, total_fill_count 990.0, total_reported_count 0.0, and priority_rank 10.
